method: 600 held 50ms commands and trapezoidal integration of all 3001 actual 100Hz poses in the final 30s (60.05-90.05s). Spin=u dot angular Jacobian dot actual qvel; original model, kinematics/comPos. No dynamics. Earlier command-boundary and every-tenth-command means are superseded.

superseded_sampling_audit.method: ALL 20Hz commands in t60 through t90 inclusive, and original-model angular Jacobian at corresponding actual qpos/qvel from the 100Hz trace. Fixed listed module groups; no new dynamics. Includes curve-update and intervening commands; does not subsample the 0.5s reshaping cycle.

superseded_sparse_check.source: U10 trace.npz actual qpos/qvel and commands.json
superseded_sparse_check.method: Original model angular Jacobian at saved actual poses, projected onto each module axis; every tenth 20Hz command in the last 30s. No new dynamics or root assignment.
superseded_sparse_check.interpretation: The solve already misses requested material spin; this does not uniquely identify root absorption or friction as the cause.
